body:
Add headless MCP tools for post authoring, post selection, and read-only preview in `crates/app/src/mcp/`.

## Scope

1. Add `list_posts`: list built-in posts and user `.cps` files from `<user_posts>`, with `serves`, `programUnits`, `extension`, and declared options (when `#2049` is present).
2. Add `select_post`: run document-level `SelectPost` (`crates/app/src/commands/post.rs`) through the MCP session `History`, closing the document-level gap noted in `crates/app/src/mcp/setup_tools.rs`.
3. Add `preview_post`: run a provided `.cps` source string or file path through `crates/app`'s read-only preview service (against a named built-in sample or the fresh document stream, with optional `post_options` and `machine`), returning `ok`, `program`, `warnings`, `swallowed`, and 1-based `errors` without writing any NC file.
4. Add `save_post_script`: atomically save a `.cps` file inside `<user_posts>` (`CAMCRAFT_POSTS` / user data dir) with plain-filename validation (rejecting paths outside the folder).
5. Document all added tools in `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`.

## Rules

- Do not expose panel open/close layout state as an MCP document command.
- Enforce `RuntimeLimits` in `preview_post` so bad scripts refuse cleanly without hanging MCP callers.

## Done means

- MCP unit/integration tests cover `list_posts`, `select_post` (including undo/redo), read-only `preview_post` (valid output, warnings, infinite loop refusal, and 1-based syntax error), and `save_post_script` filename validation.
- `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` lists the new tools accurately.

Part of #2050
